active_location.macro_silhouette: The dark, undulating expanse of the ferrofluid sea reflects the fading dusk light, its surface disturbed by geometric spikes rising and collapsing in chaotic rhythms. Towering waves of liquid metal curl and crash silently against the magnetic shore, driven by invisible forces. Distant storms of static electricity dance across the horizon, casting momentary flashes of stark white light over the churning abyss.

sensory_palette.sight: Gleaming metallic ripples and sharp spikes.
sensory_palette.sound: Deep, resonating hum of magnetic fields.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be climbed or used to shield from lateral shears.
Pulses with energy, drawing in nearby metallic debris.
A churning vortex that rapidly engulfs loose material.

reactive_toys.name_and_role: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea - Environmental Hazard
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Creating unpredictable, high-velocity ripples and spikes.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Threatens to capsize Kaio's scouting skiff or pull loose equipment into the deep.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The shear wave amplitude doubles, creating a permanent turbulent zone.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Kaio is scouting the perimeter when the shear suddenly activates.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The shear is a symptom of failing geode stabilization in this sector.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering or surviving these anomalies is required to claim the Sanctuary.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Kaio's skiff is severely damaged, forcing a dangerous trek back and losing key data.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio misreads the wave pattern, driving the skiff directly into a forming sinkhole.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio avoids the worst of the shear but loses some sensory gear in the process.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio navigates the shear perfectly, gathering valuable data on the anomaly.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio not only navigates safely but discovers a hidden pattern in the shear that predicts future anomalies.
